verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents shipping physical cards worldwide to the team (jeeves-docs-19, jeeves-docs-1). It also documents inviting team members with customized roles and permissions while issuing unlimited corporate cards (jeeves-docs-22, jeeves-docs-37), with per-employee spend limits (jeeves-docs-23, jeeves-docs-20). missing for 10: no evidence on whether cards are debit vs. credit, no detail on how roles map to card issuance or controls, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
